## Exam structure (reminder) 💬 {.smaller}

| Minutes | What happens |
|---|---|
| 1–3 | Run your tool ⚙️ |
| 3–8 | Walk me through the code 🚶 |
| 8–13 | Questions about your choices 🤔 |
| 13–15 | Hardest part, what you'd change 💭 |

# Closing 🎓

## Fourteen weeks ago {.smaller}

> "I have never opened a terminal"

Today you can:

- work in the terminal and write bash loops 🐚
- write Python: strings, lists, dictionaries, loops, functions 🐍
- read and write real biological data 🧬
- debug your own code 🔍
- collaborate with Git, branches and pull requests 👥
- analyse and plot data in R 📊

. . .

You built a working tool from nothing. That is real. 🎉

::: notes
Closing block, last 15–20 min. Optionally invite everyone back for this.
:::

## What to do next 🌱 {.smaller}

- **Use it.** The next time you would open Excel, try a script 💪
- Put one small analysis from your own studies into code 🧬
- Rosalind.info for practice puzzles 🧩
- The Carpentries lessons, free and biology-focused 🎓
- Keep your GitHub — it is your portfolio now 📁
